name: Paluxysuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Paluxysuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in Neosuchia, the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Paluxysuchus is a neosuchian crocodyliform from the Early Cretaceous Twin Mountains Formation of north-central Texas.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Twin Mountains Formation and Holly Creek Formation (PBDB).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Adams 2013
